reason: The legacy nebula-chat Butler chat (chat_cli.stream) and the shared sync request() helper treated a supervisor Core's 202 saved-request receipt as the end of the stream or as the result, so a first message to a cold project printed 'Connection ended before completion' while Core ran it and sync mutations returned the receipt. Same bug #1034 fixed for the TUI. The change reuses #1034's accepted_receipt() to follow runtime/requests/{id}/response (stream and sync) for up to two minutes without resending. Selected: the new legacy receipt regression tests (they fail on pristine main with the reported error), the shared transport contracts, and the legacy chat CLI suite.
exclusions: No full suites. No frontend, native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client and docs/CLI.md changed. tests/v3/test_chat_cli_core.py is not selected: its headless Core case fails identically on pristine origin/main locally (the headless Core process exits during startup in this environment). Supervisor 202 receipts do not occur on the create_app fixture Core; MockTransport regression tests cover them. No live provider calls or Core deployment.
